meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手就能通过 Signal 收发消息:以你现有手机号的关联设备身份,在私聊、群聊和发给自己(Note to Self)的对话里回复。支持 Markdown 排版、引用回复和私聊打字提示。
howto.when: 完成设备关联、重启服务并把 Signal 接入某个 agent 组后,已授权用户给该号码发私聊或在群里发消息时触发;新的 Signal 用户默认需要先授权。

say.text: 帮我起草一封请假邮件。
say.note: 通过已绑定的 Signal 号码发送,助手会在对话中回复。

say.text: 把我们这个群的讨论总结成三条要点。
say.note: 需在已接入的 Signal 群聊里发送,且你有权限。

say.text: 用 Markdown 格式示范一次加粗和斜体。
say.note: 可发到自己的 Note to Self,顺便验证格式转换。

howto.what_en: After installation the assistant can send and receive Signal messages, acting as a linked secondary device on your existing phone number. It replies in DMs, group chats, and your Note to Self thread, and supports Markdown, quoted replies, and DM typing indicators.
howto.when_en: After linking the device, restarting the service, and wiring the Signal account to an agent group, the assistant is triggered when an authorized user sends a DM or group message to that number; new Signal users require access first.

say_en.text: Draft a leave request email for me.
say_en.note: Send it from the linked Signal number; the assistant replies in that chat.

say_en.text: Summarize this group discussion into three bullet points.
say_en.note: Requires a wired Signal group and granted membership.

say_en.text: Give me a Markdown example with bold and italic.
say_en.note: You can send it via Note to Self to see the formatting.
